I very rarely attended the Doctor for myself but frequently attended with my children and couldn’t fault it.
The Doctors and Reception staff knew you well and were indeed very good and pleasant to deal with.
Unfortunately I developed health problems a few years ago and initially I still found them very good however now they are not fit for purpose.
Around 8 years ago my Daughter attended with her young baby and the Doctor was very rude indeed and left her in floods of tears. I have had the same experience with this Doctor both beforehand and currently and when my Grandson was still unwell the week later she asked me to go in with her. Now she is very independent and is an early years practitioner and has worked in the baby room (6 weeks upwards) for many years so she is a wonderful Mother but yet again he was very rude and was insinuating that she was just a young paranoid Mother. I spoke up as again I could see she was close to tears. In the end both she and my Grandson moved to another practice.
Recently last couple of years I have had terrible problems. Trying to get through is virtually impossible as is trying to see a Doctor. The Doctors who all know me have now retired as have most of the reception staff and I have had reason to make official complaints unfortunately.
When I say it has gone downhill I mean severely downhill.
I always praised this surgery and urged anyone new to the are to join the practice but now I get nerves in my stomach if I need to phone.
Reading the reviews it is clear I am not the only Patient who feels this way the deterioration in my opinion is severe as previously I would have given 5 stars.
Please take note of what patients are saying as your current system is not working.",null,[0,174]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfdUpmajlnRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x86c8b2feb3ec5723!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgID_uJfj9gE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfdUpmajlnRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfdUpmajlnRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURfLUpTNk5REhNDZ3dJMmJpLXZBWVEtTGZ6MUFJGi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRF91SmZqRGcSE0Nnd0lnSzYtdkFZUWdKei12d0UiEgkAAAAAAAAAABEjV-yz_rLIhioTQ2d3STJiaS12QVlRLUxmejFBSQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjn64XnurCTAxWqRoQGHS8qNpgQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwjn64XnurCTAxWqRoQGHS8qNpgQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUp2TUZoZlgxOWZSV2hFUm5WMVQxSkhMVUZNWm5aMWF6UjVaMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpsT0VOaE0yTkdVVmt3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25wSlJqWmlPR0Y1YjNGRGJXSkZZbnB2VWxKSFgzYxAB",["0x0:0x86c8b2feb3ec5723",null,1771943358638808,1771943358638808,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107475183551059360929/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Alison Mac","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXblj24OQ6shyL-0e1infgZQPNd-6E8AwH7vjYiHEPBLcdw4O9t=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107475183551059360929?hl=en"],"107475183551059360929",null,14,9,null,[1,4,1],3,["Local Guide · 14 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjn64XnurCTAxWqRoQGHS8qNpgQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"3 weeks ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["How are you ever supposed to get an appointment?
